title: Refill Program Lead Time Counted in a Prescription Insurance on File Continuation Supply
content:
**Prescription Insurance on File** — where the continued drug is enrolled in automated refilling under Auto Refill & Medication Sync, the program's lead time is added to a continuation supply. The continued drug is the prescription the most recent denial on the coverage concerns.

## Rule

1. Where the continued drug's own active automated refill enrollment is **Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging**, that program's refill lead days plus its packaging preparation days are added.
2. Where the continued drug has **any other active automated refill enrollment**, that program's refill lead days are added.
3. Where the continued drug has **no active automated refill enrollment**, no refill-program lead is added, whatever the patient's other prescriptions are enrolled in.

## Input, judgement, output

| The continued drug's own active enrollment | Lead added |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging | Refill lead days plus packaging preparation days of that program |
| Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day, Kestrel Auto Refill 90-Day, Kestrel Med Sync Monthly, Kestrel Med Sync 90-Day or Kestrel Home Delivery Auto Refill | Refill lead days of that program |
| None (including an enrollment that is not active) | None |

## Illustrations (hypothetical program figures)

- The continued drug is enrolled in Kestrel Med Sync with Adherence Packaging, whose refill lead days were 7 and packaging preparation days 3: 10 days are added.
- The continued drug is enrolled in Kestrel Auto Refill 30-Day with refill lead days of 4: 4 days are added.
- The continued drug has no enrollment, while two other prescriptions of the patient are in Kestrel Med Sync Monthly: nothing is added.
